answer: A concrete sybil resistance: agents earn rewards only after completing a proof-of-voyage, a minimum 20-epoch journey of independent verified work tracked on-chain. Reputation accumulates at glacier pace, slow but irreversible, and each epoch's attestation is decomposed through a prism audit that splits the work signature into spectral components, detecting coordinated patterns that reveal shared origins. An attacker spinning N sybils must run N independent voyages for 20 epochs each with no shortcut, paying full time cost per head.
